description: Theta-burst TMS to dorsolateral prefrontal cortex lowered subjective reports of visual awareness and impaired metacognitive ability while task performance was unimpaired (Rounis et al. 2010, as reported by Lau and Rosenthal).
limitations: Reported secondhand. The original study is not among the sources read, and no replication is reported in the sources read.

sources.quote: TMS targeted at the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex both lowered subjective reports of visual awareness and impaired metacognitive ability
